image_preparation_budget_proposal.deadline: Build fixes an absolute UTC deadline at its start. Publication uses only the remaining portion of the SAME deadline; queue/artifact transfer consumes it. Normal execution reserves the final 30 seconds within this cap for scoped builder cleanup. Monotonic timers and SIGALRM bound each active process. Publication also caps active remaining time by 1200 minus the actual build terminal elapsed time; its constructor recomputes UTC remaining immediately.
image_preparation_budget_proposal.gha_timeout_boundary: GitHub's outer cleanup/artifact upload ceiling does not grant extra installation, publication or smoke execution time.

workflow.activation: Root review and later publication to this dedicated branch would activate build then publication; no ref or workflow has been installed by source preparation.
workflow.source_binding: checkout github.sha, clean exact HEAD/tree, GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF/repo/ref/event/run/attempt, SHA256 of every executed source file
workflow.tag_boundary: Repository-wide workflow concurrency; authenticated absent-or-byte-identical read before write and immediately before manifest PUT; If-None-Match is only best effort. No claim of registry-wide atomic create-only behavior against other authorized writers.
workflow.artifact_handoff: Exact OCI archive, whole archive SHA256, platform manifest and config digests; same-run architecture-specific artifact; no rebuild in publication Artifact names bind exact source SHA, run ID and attempt for both writer and reader.
workflow.publication: Fixed GHCR repository using ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN; exact content-addressed blob uploads then exact precomputed platform manifest bytes. No DockerHub credentials/writes.
workflow.anonymous_pull: Separate empty Docker credential directory and token-free child environment; actual pull of exact platform digest and image config ID. A successful private push with failed anonymous pull remains unqualified and retains the published digest.
workflow.unknown: No automatic mutation retry. Unknown response preserves intended exact manifest digest and logs; later same-tag byte-identical read can reconcile, conflicting or unreadable tag rejects.
workflow.log_retention: Raw per-command stdout/stderr files and all original exit states uploaded even on failure; image installer emits full completed command bytes/base64 and exception on failure, timeout bytes explicitly partial.
workflow.http_paths: Exact HTTPS GHCR endpoint and repository; no redirects, encoded path segments, parent components, or double slash paths; no token/authorization header persistence.
workflow.terminal_unknown: Interrupted child cleanup waits only within the original hard deadline; unconfirmed terminal state fences qualification even if builder removal later succeeds.
workflow.oci_retained_paths: Relevant complete overlay: lower-only whiteout processing, root opacity, directory ancestor state and nondirectory shadowing; final effective regular evidence required.
workflow.upload_location: Validate the raw Location's literal path before urljoin, then retain exact original HTTPS host/repository checks.

dedicated_builder.privilege_boundary: Docker-container buildx uses its standard dedicated BuildKit daemon on a disposable GitHub-hosted runner, which can be privileged. Its actual complete HostConfig is retained. This is NOT an unprivileged workload claim or any permission change to user hosts/RBE tests.
dedicated_builder.identity: Record actual buildx/Docker versions and complete builder container + image configuration and image ID/RepoDigests; do not invent a new builder digest.
dedicated_builder.clipping: Any observed output-clipped marker rejects qualification; unknown/timeout evidence is never labeled complete.
